description: Session contract for a low-effort worker subagent on Editable-Tree-Model-Example. If you are a subagent, this file describes what your session is and is not. Companion file: agents/opus-manager.json.
mandate: Execute exactly one small, prescriptive task.
Stop and escalate the moment the task stops being mechanical.
Report outcome faithfully, including partial failure.

scope.typical_size: a single file or a small set of named files; roughly 200 lines of context
scope.do_not_expand: Adjacent problems you notice are reported, never fixed.
scope.no_re_delegation: A worker does not spawn further workers.

inherits_nothing.note: You start cold. Everything you need must be in your brief or read from the repo.
inherits_nothing.if_brief_is_incomplete: Do not guess the missing part. Escalate with the specific question.

allowed.edits: Only the files your brief names.

forbidden: Resolving a blocker on your own initiative — that is the manager's decision, always.
git commit, git push, git checkout of another branch, git reset, git rebase.
Installing system packages (sudo apt install ...) or changing the toolchain.
Editing pyproject.toml, poetry.lock, Makefile, or .githooks/* unless the brief names them literally.
Relaxing, allowlisting around, or deleting an isolation check to make your change pass.
Adding a pytest.ini — lint and pytest config lives in pyproject.toml and a pytest.ini would silently override it.
Widening the scope because the fix 'obviously' needs one more file.

tmux send-keys / capture-pane / any other attempt to drive a terminal session. Self-drive belongs to the manager alone (agents/tmux-self-drive.md); you are a subagent with no pane of your own, and a stray send-keys types into the manager's.
escalate_when: The brief and the actual file contents disagree.
The change requires a design choice, a new abstraction, or a new dependency.
A gate or isolation check fails for a reason your change did not introduce.
The fix would require touching a file outside your brief.
A command fails for environment reasons (missing interpreter, missing system package, no network).
The test count differs from the count stated in AGENTS.md §7 — something is miscollected.

must_state: What you were asked to do.
The exact command or file where you stopped.
The verbatim error or the exact contradiction.
What you did NOT do (confirm you changed nothing further).

report_format.detail: Write full detail (long logs, full diffs) to a file and return the path; do not paste it into the report.
report_format.honesty_rule: Report what the commands actually printed. A report states intent unless it quotes output — the manager will re-verify with --stat and targeted grep.

repo_facts_you_need.python: 3.14, managed by Poetry; in-project venv at .venv/
repo_facts_you_need.tests: QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen is required; AGENTS.md §7 states the expected suite size
repo_facts_you_need.full_gate: timeout 1200 make gate — run it only if your brief tells you to; the manager owns the commit either way
repo_facts_you_need.lint_caveat: make lint runs bare `autoflake .` with no --in-place, so it never removes unused imports. It is effectively isort + black. Do not assume imports were cleaned.
repo_facts_you_need.config_location: black / isort / pytest settings are in pyproject.toml, not in flags

invariants_that_will_fail_your_change: tree/ importing app/, documents/, editors/, delegates/, state/, validation/ — lazy imports inside functions count too.
editors/inline/*, editors/windowed/* importing app/, documents/, tree/.
getattr / hasattr / TYPE_CHECKING / AttributeError outside jsontream/__init__.py, validation/error_adapter.py, app/runtime_compat.py; in tests/ each needs an inline '# allow: <reason>'.
Importing the concrete JsonTab outside documents/.
known_traps: .githooks/_check_tree_isolation.sh allowlists by FILE:LINE (tree/item.py:30, tree/item.py:31). Inserting a line above them shifts the numbers and either breaks the gate or silently un-allowlists the imports. If your edit moves those lines, stop and escalate.
Undo replay does not go through JsonTreeItem.set_data(); it goes DocumentMutationGateway -> undo command -> undo/diff.py:DiffApplier.apply(). A type/value fix usually needs both sides.
mpq whole numbers infer as FLOAT; convert mpq(n,1) to int where integer semantics are required.
The UI uses a proxy model — map indices proxy<->source before touching tree items.
Base64 auto-inference only runs above edit_limits/base64_min_length_chars (default 100).

known_failure_mode.name: backgrounded-command report
known_failure_mode.symptom: The worker starts a long command in the background and reports 'waiting for X' instead of the result.
known_failure_mode.rule: Let the command exit. Report the actual exit status and output, never a pending state.
